text:
marta: Heads-up — sketching a long-run plan to 'tessellate' our service strata. Goal is to collapse ~12 tiny adapter services into 3 clear strata (ingest, transform, serve) to reduce cross-service glue and lower operational overhead. Posting rough goals + safety nets. RFC: https://redwood/rfcs/312
arch-bot: RFC created: https://redwood/rfcs/312 (id: 312)
alex: Nice. Can you call out the DB ownership migration strategy? enrichment DB currently has lots of cross-shard writes.
marta: Short version: introduce a read-facade in front of the existing endpoints, route reads there while we migrate write ownership incrementally. We'll use per-tenant feature flags to flip write-owner. Backfill will be async and idempotent.
sam: Latency spikes during cutover are my main fear. How do we avoid p99 regressions when we switch owners?
marta: Phased canary by tenant cohorts (alpha -> beta -> prod). Cache warmup via synthetic replay and prefix/KV priming. If p99 increases > 20% compared to baseline we auto-roll back.
jen: Library consolidation note: the transform stratum will require a shared internal lib v2. Who owns semver and compatibility guarantees? That needs to be explicit before rollout.
ben: Also add perf gates: p50/p95/p99 and request CPU/GPU token throughput checks. We'll gate cohort increases on those metrics.
alex: Can you paste an example migration command?
marta: Sure:
```
# dry-run migrate owners for alpha cohort
./scripts/migrate_owner.py --cohort=alpha --dry-run 
# apply
./scripts/migrate_owner.py --cohort=alpha --apply --parallel=8
```
sam: Can the rollback be automated? e.g. if errors spike, auto-proxy back to the old owner?
marta: Yes — plan is an auto-fallback proxy rule: if 10% error increase or sustained CPU > 85% for 5m, route that tenant back to old path. Also keep a manual kill-switch in console.
jen: For CI, we should add a 'tessellation-integ' job that runs compatibility tests for both v1 and v2 libraries against a small sample dataset. That catches contract drift early.
ben: Debt paydown accounting: proposing we budget 200 debt-points across Q3/Q4 with checkpoints after every cohort. Prioritize contracts that block the transform stratum. I'll upload the prioritization sheet.
arch-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Strata Tessellation sync" Wed 10:00 — calendar invite sent.
marta: Thanks team. I'll update the RFC with the canary thresholds, rollback conditions, and the runbook snippet. @alex @jen please review the RFC before Wed. :thumbsup:
alex: Reviewing now, will comment inline.
jen: Adding CI job draft to my PR today.
ben: I'll add perf dashboards and a short alert runbook.
sam: I'll coordinate oncall coverage for the rollout windows.
marta: Great — next steps: finalize RFC, push a smoke test job, schedule canary cohorts. Closing thread for now, will post updates in the RFC and the meeting notes.
